# Keenable interface icon

The Keenable icon in `src/assets/ai-logos/keenable.png` is the official favicon
referenced by https://keenable.ai/ on 13 November 2026. It identifies the optional
Keenable search integration and does not imply endorsement. Keenable retains its
branding/trademark rights.
